name: mors
source:
A short, atmospheric experience set in the early twentieth century, revolving around an unsolved murder case. The story is tailored by the decisions you make.

[From [url=https://srmp1.itch.io/mors]Itch.io[/url]]

這是一段短暫而氛圍濃厚的體驗，設定在20世紀初，圍繞一樁懸而未決的謀殺案展開。故事將隨著你的選擇而變化。
